selection_rule: Within each category, enumerate 4-argument combinations and then 4-function combinations in JSON order; select the first block for which every cell passes contextual tokenization, distinct-answer, and clean-top-1 gates.
argument_rule: The argument surface in its prompt must align to exactly one contextual token and the standalone leading-space form must be one token.
